# RM brief — ESHAN LTD (13104118)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-01 — Late filing of annual accounts; CON-03 — Pattern of late filing; CON-04 — Micro-entity accounts; SEC-01 — Outstanding third-party charge; SEC-06 — Multiple simultaneous charges to one lender; SEC-07 — Negative pledge  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- ESHAN LTD (company number 13104118) is an active private limited company incorporated on 30 December 2020, operating in other letting and operating of own or leased real estate (SIC 68209), with a single active officer who is the only officer ever appointed. `[profile; officers]`
- The company has two outstanding charges, both created on 9 February 2022 in favour of Charter Court Financial Services Limited, each secured on leasehold land at flat 2 Kavan Court, 51 Ancaster Road, Beckenham BR3 4DZ. As these are third-party charges, no first-charge facility can be offered and any new lending would rank as a second charge unless they are redeemed at completion. `[131041180004; 131041180003; SEC-01]`
- Two earlier charges to Lloyds Bank PLC, both created on 4 February 2022, are recorded as fully satisfied; these are disregarded for ranking purposes but evidence prior borrowing capacity. `[131041180002; 131041180001; SEC-03]`
- Both pairs of charges (Charter Court and Lloyds) were created within 30 days of each other for the same lender, indicating structured or tranched facilities, so full redemption figures for all charges are required before any refinance is quoted. `[SEC-06; 131041180003; 131041180004; 131041180001; 131041180002]`
- All four charges contain a negative pledge, so written consent from the existing lender must be evidenced before any further charge is created over the same security. `[SEC-07; 131041180004; 131041180003; 131041180002; 131041180001]`
- Filing conduct is poor: accounts have been filed late in each of the last three years — 94 days late on 30 September 2024, 67 days late on 3 September 2025 and 93 days late on 29 September 2026 — which is a pattern rather than an isolated lapse. `[CON-01; CON-03; AA filed 2024-09-30; AA filed 2025-09-03; AA filed 2026-09-29]`
- The latest accounts, made up to 30 September 2025, are total exemption full and disclose no turnover or profit, so management accounts covering the most recent 12 months must be obtained before a decision; the next accounts are not due until 30 June 2027 and nothing is currently overdue. `[CON-04; AA filed 2026-09-29; profile; computed]`
